3cc1cf19507251dd37da061d212c3bd758e2633e

### Toxcore Version

0.2.20

### Qt Version

6.4.2

### Steps to reproduce

1. Start qTox
2. Have a chat where someone sends files (pictures for example).
3. Make the window quite small (on Linux this is how I can reproduce, on macOS it happens a lot more).
4. Scroll up and down (maybe you need to send some messages to fill the chat log with something to scroll around in).

### Observed Behavior

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/953af64a-9e9f-4aea-ae79-c12ed56089a5)


### Expected Behavior

The green box should only be partially shown and stop at the horizontal line.

### Reproducibility

Always

### Operating System

Linux

### Operating System version/distro/name/etc.

Debian GNU/Linux

### Relevant log output

```shell
Nothing special to see in the logs.
```

comment_data.body: It's an old bug that is not clear how to trigger and it appears randomly. I never found why it happens at all.
I can reliably reproduce it, so I'll investigate after the release.
Unclear whether #678 actually fixes it, as I can't currently repro this.
